songs.title: Puente de Lluvia
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
La quebrada se llevó el puente de madera,
y el pueblo amaneció partido en dos.
Mi abuela puso piedras en la orilla
y dijo: «el río escucha nuestra voz».

[Pre-Chorus]
Uno trajo tablas; otro, la comida.
Nadie preguntó quién iba a mandar.

[Chorus]
Puente de lluvia, vuelve a levantarte;
no por el hierro, sino por las manos.
Si el agua borra el nombre del camino,
lo escribiremos juntos, paso a paso.

[Verse 2]
La gaita fue marcando la mañana;
los niños aprendieron a esperar.
Al cruzar la primera bicicleta,
mi abuela sonrió sin celebrar.

[Chorus]
Puente de lluvia, vuelve a levantarte;
no por el hierro, sino por las manos.
Si el agua borra el nombre del camino,
lo escribiremos juntos, paso a paso.

[Outro]
Lo escribiremos juntos, paso a paso.

[Intro]
(A brief opening before the first line of northbound)

[Verse]
We moved through the weather with our hands open wide
We counted the lights as they opened one by one
I gathered the silence and gave it a name
A clear little thunder kept time in my head
Then fields beyond the highway answered, and nothing stayed the same
Every step carried a life not mapped yet under its sound

[Pre Chorus]
I can feel a life not mapped yet drawing near
What was only a whisper is suddenly clear

[Chorus]
If the road keeps changing, I will change too
Hold to the bright line, hold to the sound
I am still becoming when I come back to you
I found a new way to be honest with you

[Verse]
Letting a life not mapped yet walk for a while at our side
There was a dashboard glow, keeping more than it showed
The street held its breath at the edge of the sun
What I could not say found a rhythm instead
I called to the distance and the distance came round
I followed fields beyond the highway where the evening turned slow

[Bridge]
There is room for tomorrow in the weight that we share
I can release what I cannot repair
Let the old walls soften, let the new light in
We do not need permission to begin again

[Chorus]
If the road keeps changing, I will change too
Hold to the bright line, hold to the sound
I am still becoming when I come back to you
I found a new way to be honest with you

[Outro]
If the road keeps changing, I will change too
(Let the final phrase trail into the arrangement)
songs.artworkCredit: Dejan Krsmanovic · Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0；灵感音乐剪裁及排版

Then heat above the sidewalk answered, and nothing stayed the same
Every step carried a season moving too fast under its sound
Letting a season moving too fast walk for a while at our side
There was an open car window, keeping more than it showed
We counted the lights as they opened one by one
What I could not say found a rhythm instead

[Bridge]
There is room for tomorrow in the weight that we share
Let the old walls soften, let the new light in
No perfect answer, no borrowed disguise
I can release what I cannot repair

[Chorus]
Carry me through the summer static, carry me clear
I found a new way to be honest with you
I am still becoming when I come back to you
Turn up the heart of it, I want to hear

[Outro]
Carry me through the summer static, carry me clear
(Let the final phrase trail into the arrangement)
